mentions.name: FUGC
mentions.description: Concurrent garbage collector (FUGC) that is part of Fil-C. Current work is debugging a rare concurrency bug, possibly related to large objects, that reproduces about once a day under ideal conditions using an Emacs bootstrap loop with FUGC_VERIFY=1 and about once a month otherwise.
mentions.problem: Low-probability concurrent GC bugs that are difficult to reproduce, seemingly related to large objects.
mentions.source_excerpt: Trying to hunt down a GC bug in https://fil-c.org/fugc
